title: EVT-FRAME
description: Telemetry frame, PC to device. Projects ENTITY-FRAME. Every telemetry element is always present; null means the running title cannot supply it. Absence of a key is malformed, never unavailable.

protocolMajor.description: Same major means compatible. A differing major is refused whole.

protocolMinor.description: A differing minor is tolerated; unknown fields are ignored. This is why additionalProperties is true.

status.description: Frames are published whenever the plugin is alive, so silence means exactly one thing: the PC side is unreachable.

titleId.description: The declaring adapter's title, or the unsupported title's identity. NOT a telemetry element: INV-STATUS-CONSISTENT exempts it, because naming the title is the entire point of unsupportedTitle.

stamp.description: Monotonic milliseconds within a producer run. Orders frames; does not measure latency, since the two clocks are not synchronised.

gear.description: R, N, or 1-18. A string, matching what SimHub itself supplies.

rampStartRpm.description: Absolute RPM, already resolved by the adapter. For iRacing this is DriverCarSLFirstRPM.

flashRpm.description: Absolute RPM. For iRacing this is DriverCarSLShiftRPM - the sim's own 'shift now'.

spotterLeft.description: null means the title has no proximity source. 'none' means the track is clear. Collapsing the two is the failure this contract exists to prevent.

allOf.$comment: INV-STATUS-CONSISTENT: a non-live frame carries every telemetry element as null. titleId is exempt.
